name: ag2-toolkit-result-caching-with-coherent-73fe
instr:
Let callers compose bounded, coherent result caching around a toolkit without wrapping individual tools. Reuse must be deterministic, observable, safe under concurrency, and sensitive to provider controls and mutable local resources. Toolkits used directly or with caching disabled retain their existing behavior.

Eligible successful calls reuse results by toolkit, tool name, resolved arguments, and policy namespace; unsupported identities raise `UncacheableCallError`, whose `value_type` identifies the unsupported type, before lookup. `build_cache_key(namespace, tool_name, arguments)` canonicalizes nested JSON-compatible values without conflating their types. Equivalent concurrent misses share execution, but waiter cancellation does not cancel remaining demand, and failures or cancellations never create reusable records. Every cached attempt emits one `ToolCacheEvent` before its result, preserving current call identity, parent ids, batch order, middleware observations, and custom names. ExaToolkit, TinyFishSearchToolkit, SerplySearchToolkit, XquikSearchToolkit, and PerplexitySearchToolkit isolate endpoints and every response-shaping control, and never retain transport failures. SkillSearchToolkit and SkillsToolkit invalidate successful mutations and runtime-shadow changes while rejected mutations preserve valid records.
